metadata.name: Mean Annual Ground Temperature (MAGTM) and Related Permafrost Data for Antarctica
metadata.description: This dataset contains metadata for files related to Mean Annual Ground Temperature (MAGTM), its standard deviation, permafrost probability fraction, and a thumbnail image for Antarctica. The files are in ZIP and JPG formats, with sizes ranging from 716.7 to 1908.86 units. The temporal coverage is inferred from the file names as 2000 to 2017.
